```js
import { PlaneGeometry, Group, Mesh, MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { texture, uv, vec2, vec4, mix, color, float, Fn } from 'three/tsl';
import gsap from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  // --- Configuration ---
  const position = new THREE.Vector3(-3.2, 1, 0.06);
  const rotation = new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 0);
  const scale = new THREE.Vector3(1, 1, 1);
  
  const atlasRect = { x: 0, y: 0, w: 512, h: 320 };
  const aspect = atlasRect.w / atlasRect.h; // 1.6
  
  // Plane dimensions in scene units
  const planeHeight = 0.8;
  const planeWidth = planeHeight * aspect; // 1.28
  
  // --- Load texture ---
  const srcTexture = ctx.textureLoader('/prism-mock/home/nodes/floating-accent.png');
  
  // Get atlas dimensions from texture image
  const atlasW = srcTexture.image?.width || atlasRect.w;
  const atlasH = srcTexture.image?.height || atlasRect.h;
  
  // Set UV offset/repeat for atlas region
  srcTexture.offset.set(
    atlasRect.x / atlasW,
    1 - (atlasRect.y + atlasRect.h) / atlasH
  );
  srcTexture.repeat.set(
    atlasRect.w / atlasW,
    atlasRect.h / atlasH
  );
  srcTexture.needsUpdate = true;
  
  // --- Create plane geometry ---
  const geometry = new PlaneGeometry(planeWidth, planeHeight);
  
  // --- Create material with TSL nodes ---
  const material = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
  material.transparent = true;
  
  // Texture node
  const texNode = texture(srcTexture);
  
  // Subtle grain effect
  const grainNoise = Fn(() => {
    const uvCoord = uv();
    const noise = hash(uvCoord.mul(2048.0)).sub(0.5).mul(0.04);
    return noise;
  });
  
  // Engineered gradient overlay (accent to surface)
  const gradientFactor = uv().y.sub(0.3).clamp(0, 1);
  const gradientColor = mix(
    color('#0b0b10'),
    color('#ff2a38').mul(0.3),
    gradientFactor
  );
  
  // Combine: texture + gradient + grain
  const baseColor = texNode.rgb;
  const finalColor = baseColor.mul(0.85).add(gradientColor.mul(0.15)).add(grainNoise());
  const finalAlpha = texNode.a;
  
  material.colorNode = vec4(finalColor, finalAlpha);
  
  // --- Create mesh ---
  const planeMesh = new Mesh(geometry, material);
  planeMesh.position.set(0, 0, 0);
  
  // --- Create text ---
  let textMesh = null;
  if (config.textContent && ctx.fontAtlas) {
    textMesh = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(config.textContent.text, {
      font: 'Lora',
      weight: 400,
      size: 0.18, // scene units for label text
      color: 0xe8ecf2,
      align: 'center',
    });
    if (textMesh) {
      textMesh.position.set(0, -0.05, 0.002); // slightly in front of plane
    }
  }
  
  // --- Create group ---
  const group = new Group();
  group.position.copy(position);
  group.rotation.copy(rotation);
  group.scale.copy(scale);
  group.add(planeMesh);
  if (textMesh) group.add(textMesh);
  
  // --- Animation ---
  const tl = gsap.timeline();
  tl.from(group.position, {
    y: position.y + 0.4,
    duration: 0.7,
    ease: 'power3.out',
  });

  // Actually, group.material doesn't exist. Let me animate the material opacity.

  // --- Cleanup ---
  group.userData.cleanup = () => {
    tl.kill();
    geometry.dispose();
    material.dispose();
    if (srcTexture.dispose) srcTexture.dispose();
  };
  
  // --- Event handlers ---
  group.userData.handlers = {};
  
  return group;
}
```
